clues.question: The turn of the century Carnation Gold Rush occurred in what U.S. state capital that's now home to The Red Rocks Amphitheatre?
The suburbs of Littleton and Aurora are next to what U.S. city whose Capitol building has a step that's located at exactly 5,280 ft above sea level?
A basin, an omelet, and a supposedly cursed international airport are all named after what capital of Colorado?
In a 2005 commercial, Melania Trump swapped bodies with the spokes-creature for what Columbus, Georgia company?
After the original was fired for insensitive tweets, Dan McKeague started voicing said spokesbird for what accident and disability insurance company?
Perpetually trying to quack out its five-letter acronym, the late Gilbert Gottfried was the longtime voice of what company's waterfowl mascot?
Chanticleer the rooster and three rogues who find Death under an oak tree appear in what unfinished iambic pentameter poem?
After a plague, a Knight, a Miller, and the Wife of Bath are on their way to the shrine of Thomas Beckett in what Middle English work?
Geoffrey Chaucer wrote what short story collection about a group of pilgrims swapping stories while on their way to a certain English "-bury"?
Hanif Abdurraqib's 2019 book "Go Ahead in the Rain" was a "love letter" to what '90s Big Apple hip-hop quartet?
The Source gave its first five-mic award to what Q-Tip-led band, for the album "People's Instinctive Travels and the Paths of Rhythm"?
Crush Connection and Quest were early names for what group that featured one of those words in its their name?
The Great Smoky Mountains National Park now requires entrants to participate in a lottery in order to catch the early summer displays of what insects?
Producing the chemical luciferin, what bugs in the Lampyridae family will kill you if you eat about 20?
Don't tell Nathan Fillion, but most of the Western U.S. species of what beetle do not glow in the dark?
